subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Exuberance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vibrancy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exuberance **means overflowing energy and enthusiasm. (भरपूर ऊर्जा और उत्साह)

 
 
• **Example**: *The exuberance of the crowd at the concert was infectious, with everyone dancing and singing along with the music.*
 
 
 
• **Vibrancy **is a synonym of exuberance, meaning liveliness and energy. (जीवंतता और ऊर्जा)
 
 
• **Example**: *The city's vibrant street markets, filled with colourful stalls and lively music, showcase the vibrancy of its diverse culture.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laziness**: A disinclination to work or use energy; idleness. (आलस्य)
 
• **Sympathy**: Understanding and sharing feelings with someone in times of joy or sorrow; compassion. (सहानुभूति)
 
• **Impartiality**: Treating all parties, views, or people equally and without bias; fairness. (निष्पक्षता)
